text:
The sympathetic innervation to the colon and distal GI tract arises from the thoracolumbar cord, specifically T10–L2 (the lesser splanchnic and lumbar splanchnic nerves), not from lumbosacral segments. The note's claim that sympathetic supply to the lower gut comes from L3–L5/S2–S4 is incorrect—those segments provide parasympathetic (S2–S4) innervation. Therefore the answer is T10–L2.

CONFIDENCE: 90
